answer: Each of 447 aliases needs its own job histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A freelance platform tenure with completed-job history works as the gate: jobs completed under one profile across many years. The dawn check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The ripple record is public, the pulse cost is per identity, and 447 aliases cost 447 times one honest seat.
